questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road will join from the right at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs tell drivers where to go around blocked roads. This detour sign shows an alternate route when the main road is closed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and check for vehicles and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful around construction zones. This sign tells drivers that roadwork is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming and tells you to reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a shared center lane for left turns. Drivers from both directions can only use this lane for turning left. Do not use it as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that road work is ahead. Follow the detour signs to avoid the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead has low clearance. Be careful if you are driving a tall vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will make a sharp turn to the right, then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they will stop. If you are following this vehicle, be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Drive carefully and be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Slow down and drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging into your lane, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near traffic. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts drivers that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that a playground is nearby and children may be on or near the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts drivers that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns drivers to watch for traffic entering from an upcoming side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only flow in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign with black markings alerts drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop or slow down for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a center lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. This lane cannot be used for passing or driving straight through.
